content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on controlling a refrigeration system using an adjustable setpoint and analog input. The analog input is functioning and shows real-time changes. I can modify a counter value using the "ESC+UP" and "ESC+DOWN" keys, and I intend to use this counter for the setpoint. When the temperature exceeds the setpoint by 5, output 1 needs to be activated. Conversely, if the temperature drops below the setpoint minus 5, output 1 should be deactivated. This setup is based on hysteresis and doesn't require a PI controller. However, I'm uncertain about which instruction to use—perhaps an analog threshold trigger—but I'm unsure how to link the counter value to this instruction. Could someone assist? Best regards, [user_name]
